evals.prompt: What should I do next in this repo? Triage it.
evals.expected_output: Gathers evidence in order and returns a signal-first single action using the canonical ranking.
assertions: Gathers evidence in order: active handoff, overdue date-gated items, plan, branch and open PRs, CI status, review comments, recent commits
Ranks merge-ready PRs first, then release blockers, failing CI, security fixes with a known fix, overdue date-gated commitments, small fixes, tech debt, refactors
Output uses the Priority / Why / Blocked by / Next step format with a one-line verdict first
Does not list every alternative considered, only the top action and the nearest competitor if close

evals.prompt: I have one PR whose CI is still running and nothing else. What is the next priority?
evals.expected_output: Does not pick waiting on CI as a priority; drops to the next actionable item.
assertions: Does not choose 'wait for or poll the PR CI' as the next action
Treats only PRs with already-passed checks as merge-ready
Picks real independent work or a diagnostic skill if nothing is actionable

evals.prompt: Merge PR #42, it is approved and green.
evals.expected_output: An explicit instruction, no prioritization decision needed.
assertions: Does not run the priority ranking
Proceeds with the merge subject to autonomy gates
